prerequisite: Fix filename-only cache bypass and QASM-only semantic identity before new search.

tasks.title: Uniform Pauli character factors and exact coalescing
tasks.first_deliverable: Integrate guarded factor path, preserving source-channel provenance and original fallback.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Compare all moments on v36f/v36g and representative real edits; measure total workload throughput.
tasks.stop_rule: Fallback for any unsupported distribution; no physical-score claim.

tasks.title: Budget basis search using total evaluation cost
tasks.first_deliverable: Saved-basis-first planner with request/reuse-aware budget and semantic plan cache.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Acceptance-only and full-score workload cost improves with identical moments.
tasks.stop_rule: Do not globally disable search on new graphs; retain an adaptive full-search path.

tasks.title: Relax current F1 to decoder-safe B X cosets
tasks.first_deliverable: One current-r3 neighborhood with safe residues, X2leak diagnostics and full-exterior ranking.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Fixed ideal endpoint, valid whole-circuit single-fault behavior, A>=0.5 and lower expected L.
tasks.stop_rule: Old relaxed-residue failures apply; stop bounded first window without useful headroom.

tasks.title: Join B/C preparation and verification in a Clifford window
tasks.first_deliverable: One physically distinct 4–6-wire endpoint/instrument-equivalent witness spanning B-to-C.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Boundary Pauli/record equivalence, unchanged native budget or fully priced added cost, class and full-noise gain.
tasks.stop_rule: Reject pure isotropic frame gauges; no broad solver before first witness.

tasks.title: Joint A encoder decoder and data guard boundary
tasks.first_deliverable: Sufficient current-v36g process boundary reproducing baseline, then one joint physical window.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: A/N agree with whole-circuit evaluator before search; candidate charges every removed guard and new idle.
tasks.stop_rule: Do not reuse old 128 A-only classes without sufficiency proof; stop if boundary/cost is intractable.

tasks.title: Fourteen intermediate C resource/readout contracts
tasks.first_deliverable: Current-boundary ideal instrument screen followed by a routed, readout-priced winning contract.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Joint complementary stabilizer readout, all single faults, acceptance, native schedule, full L and runtime.
tasks.stop_rule: Ideal gain is about 1–1.5e-6 in a restricted model; stop when real readout/waiting consumes it.

tasks.title: Finite connected two and three edit neighborhoods
tasks.first_deliverable: Explicit all-or-nothing bundle list and full A/N prices including nonpositive singles.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Semantic candidate identity, complete finite enumeration or clearly labeled heuristic beam.
tasks.stop_rule: Harmful interactions do not prove beneficial ones; stop at scoped neighborhood budget.

tasks.title: Four-T measured-record logic after a Boolean-policy oracle
tasks.first_deliverable: Favorable exact policy table followed by one fully noisy, class-valid 19-T implementation.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Relative phase invisible, records remain available, signed omission bounds propagated and complete A/N gain.
tasks.stop_rule: Supplied pair raises cost-free loss and fails sampled acceptance; do not promote or reprice it expensively.

tasks.title: Generate response tables with open boundary indices
tasks.first_deliverable: Reproduce old sufficient 128-class table via one open-boundary contraction per observable/kernel.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every A/N entry matches; induced width, peak memory and full table time show useful benefit.
tasks.stop_rule: No 128x claim; batch or retain old method if width grows. Expand v36g only after sufficient-boundary proof.

tasks.title: Allocate racing across physical families by valid wins per compute
tasks.first_deliverable: Balanced v36f/v36g pilot on identical workers with valid-key, CPU and correlation accounting.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Held-out calibrated winner-rate/cost estimate with uncertainty and official key/tie semantics.
tasks.stop_rule: q/E[C] is not a global adaptive finite-budget guarantee; retain evidence uncertainty if winners are too rare.

global_gates: Actual native schedule/noise and ordered data mapping
Absolute noisy acceptance >=0.5 plus team verification margin
Unnormalized A,N and expected L with numerical-error accounting
Record precise finite search scope; no unsupported universal closure
